agent.problem: Nothing in the earlier cards makes three years more reasoned than seven or forty. Card 4 says only that Isaiah obeyed and walked around naked and barefoot, so the baker can fill this blank only by guessing an undisclosed number.

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: The right answer is stated fully in Isaiah 20:4. Isaiah 20:3 supplies the question's already-established setup about the sign against Egypt and Cush, so the citation Isaiah 20:3-4 is wider than the verses of the right answer.

rule.text: A choice card cites only the verses of its right answer.
